how.0.title: Priprava krme
how.0.desc: Concentrated liquid feed is filtered and pumped to the atomizer at controlled flow and pressure.
how.1.title: Atomization
how.1.desc: The feed is dispersed into millions of fine droplets by a nozzle or high-speed rotary disc.
how.2.title: Hot Air Contact
how.2.desc: Filtered, heated air meets the droplet cloud; water evaporates almost instantly.
how.3.title: Powder Formation
how.3.desc: Dried particles fall to the conical chamber base while moist air carries fines upward.
how.4.title: Separation & Recovery
how.4.desc: Cyclones and bag filters separate powder from exhaust air and recover fines.
how.5.title: Collection / After-Drying
how.5.desc: Powder is collected, optionally agglomerated and cooled in a fluid bed before packing.

tagline: Pretvorite tekočo krmo v sipki prašek v eni sami neprekinjeni operaciji.
overview.p0: Gausin Spray Dryer spremeni črpalno tekočo krmo (raztopino, suspenzijo ali goščo) v suh prah tako, da jo razprši v tok vročega zraka za sušenje.
overview.p1: Na voljo sta dve možnosti razprševanja: visokotlačni / dvotekočinski razpršilniki šobe za grobe, prosto tekoče praške in hitri rotacijski razpršilci za fine, enotne velikosti delcev.
overview.p2: Vsaka naprava je zasnovana s simulacijo masne in energijske bilance, rekuperacijo drobnih delcev ciklona/vrečastega filtra in izbirnim naknadnim sušenjem z vrtinčeno plastjo za aglomerirane instant praške brez prahu.
